By Listen-Learn-Earn: Stellar Attestation

"Listen-Learn-Earn: Stellar Attestation"

SCF #46
$150.0K
Build
Submitted

Products & Services

This Build Award adds four capabilities: (1) on-chain attestation — learning outcomes, creator graduations, and redemptions written to Stellar, creating independently verifiable impact records; (2) SHEQ Points → Stellar asset conversion at the platform level (trustline issuance, Soroban milestone logic later); (3) redemption rails via Stellar Disbursement Platform + Anchor Platform to SSLCommerz, delivering taka (bKash, Nagad, airtime) — users never hold digital assets; (4) a public verification dashboard letting any funder audit outcomes directly from chain data. Together: verified learn-to-earn, deployable across crypto-restricted markets.

Requested Budget

$150.0K

Tranche 1 (Deliverable Roadmap) - MVP

TRANCHE 1 — MVP on Testnet (Weeks 1-6) · $45,000

  • Architecture specification + attestation data schema (completions, creator graduations, redemptions) — $8,000 · Verify: spec document

  • Stellar SDK ramp, testnet accounts, asset design — $5,000 · Verify: funded testnet accounts, asset config

  • Attestation engine on testnet: Merkle-batched cohort data via manage_data/memo transactions (core layer feeding SDP) — $18,000 · Verify: testnet transaction history from registered accounts

  • SHEQ Points → Stellar asset conversion prototype: trustline issuance of the asset SDP will disburse — $10,000 · Verify: working testnet demo

  • Multi-tenant scaffolding (per-country deployability) — $4,000 · Verify: config-driven second-tenant demo

Tranche 2 (Deliverable Roadmap) - Testnet

TRANCHE 2 — Full Testnet Loop (Weeks 7-10) · $50,000

  • ANCHOR PLATFORM: SEP-10 auth + SEP-24 deposit/withdraw against the SSLCommerz taka anchor (listed est.: 1+ month) — $12,000 · Verify: passing SEP compliance tests on testnet

  • SDP: disbursement/redemption flow to sandboxed SSLCommerz/bKash/Nagad/airtime rails (listed est.: 1-2 weeks) — $15,000 · Verify: end-to-end sandbox redemption logs

  • Full Listen-Learn-Earn loop with simulated pilot cohort — $8,000 · Verify: demo video + testnet transaction trail

  • STRIDE threat model + on-chain monitoring plan (per SDF templates) — $7,000 · Verify: both documents delivered

  • Localized wallet/redemption UX (Bengali; French/Arabic scaffolding) — $8,000 · Verify: localized build demo

Tranche 3 (Deliverable Roadmap) - Mainnet

TRANCHE 3 — Mainnet Launch (Weeks 11-12) · $55,000

  • Production attestation + mainnet asset issuance (U.S.-entity accounts) — $20,000 · Verify: mainnet issuing account + live transactions

  • ANCHOR PLATFORM + SDP: live SSLCommerz redemption on mainnet (taka-only delivery) — $15,000 · Verify: production redemption records (privacy-preserving)

  • Public verification dashboard reading on-chain data — $12,000 · Verify: live dashboard URL

  • Security audit remediation + open-source release of Soroban components (Apache 2.0) — $8,000 · Verify: audit report + public repository

Tranche 3 Onchain Metric Information

1. Metric: Cumulative on-chain transaction volume from our registered footprint — specifically, attestation transactions (manage_data/memo-anchored records of learning completions, creator graduations, and reward redemptions) written from SHEQONOMI's app-operated accounts, plus the associated redemption disbursement volume moved via SDP between our issuing and distribution accounts. This is the "equivalent on-chain measure appropriate to the integration": our product's core function is verified outcomes, so verified-outcome transactions are our usage.

2. Completion target: 5,000+ cumulative attestation transactions within an 8-week measurement window following Mainnet launch, corresponding to the Cox's Bazar pilot cohort's learning and redemption events — a modest, credible threshold demonstrating real usage from a live cohort, not an aggressive growth target. We welcome panel ratification or adjustment. Our goal is to announce SHEQONOMI on Stellar on March 8th, 2027, International Women's Day with all of our collective global partners (Stellar + SHEQONOMI, Islamic Development Bank) and hopefully alongside UNHCR Innovation Accelerator.

3. Tracking and reporting: At award time we will register our on-chain footprint — asset issuing account, app-operated attestation/batching wallets, and Soroban contract IDs (if deployed in later tranches) — so every transaction is attributable to SHEQONOMI. Tracking is via Horizon/RPC queries against those registered accounts, surfaced on our public verification dashboard (a Tranche 3 deliverable) where SCF, UNHCR, or anyone can independently recompute the count directly from chain data. We'll include the running metric in each tranche report.

Final-Tranche Metric Commitment

5,000+ cumulative attestation transactions from SHEQONOMI's registered footprint (issuing account, app-operated wallets, Soroban contract IDs if deployed) within an 8-week measurement window after Mainnet launch — tracked via Horizon/RPC and surfaced on the public verification dashboard.

ENGINEERING: pressure-test the 5,000 figure. The Merkle batching factor (events per batch) directly drives on-chain transaction count. If batching materially reduces the count, we will ratify or adjust according to technical teams recommendations (yours and ours). We will partner with women in tech, women in blockchain, women in crypto communities globally in reaching our 5,000 cumulative attestation transactions.
